deadline.value: Applications for fall enrollment with financial support must be complete by January 15, 2027.
deadline.quote: Application materials for consideration for fall enrollment with financial support must be received by January 15

gre_subject.value: The catalog names no subject test for this PhD.

gre_general.value: The department requires a GRE of at least 310 combined with a quantitative score of 160, and a UA Applied Statistics MS can waive it.
gre_general.quote: GRE score of at least 310 (verbal + quantitative, with a quantitative score of at least 160)

also.quote: Students who graduated from or are currently enrolled in the Applied Statistics, MS program at the University of Alabama are eligible for a GRE test score requirement waiver

supervisor.value: The catalog says a dissertation advisor must be found by the end of the comprehensive exam, but not before admission.
supervisor.quote: By the end of the comprehensive exam at the latest, students are expected to find a dissertation advisor.

funding.value: Financial support is typically available for the first four years for PhD students who meet performance expectations.
funding.quote: Financial support is typically available through the first four years in the program for PhD students who meet performance

entry_route.value: The catalog page does not state a degree-level rule for this PhD.

toefl_min.value: The department requires a TOEFL of at least 90, which is higher than the graduate school minimum.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL score of of at least 90, an IELTS score of at least 7.0

ielts_min.value: The department requires an IELTS of at least 7.0, which is higher than the graduate school minimum.
ielts_min.quote: an IELTS score of at least 7.0

notes: The PhD is admitted by the Culverhouse College of Business (Information Systems, Statistics and Management Science), so its GRE and English rules are given as overrides.
